notes: Strong inseparable verb: past 'verstand', participle 'hat verstanden'.
Often used when you cannot hear someone clearly: 'Ich kann dich kaum verstehen' (I can barely hear/understand you).
Reflexive 'sich verstehen (mit + dative)' means to get along well with someone.
